profile.summary: Excellent experience in design, diagnosis, development, website redesign, coding, testing and support of Telecommunication applications such as Centers Compliance Web Tool, Compensation Abstract, Compensation Builder, Quota Tool, HealthCare applications (Auto Mileage, Hospice Compliance Audit Tool, OdyInfo, Time Sheet), Tele Comm. Applications (Project Center, WRMS, Road Block ) , HealthCare Insurance Claim applications ( Benefit Automator), Manufacturing and Retail Industry applications ( NSRF appl.) , Rail Road applications (iTrax Rail Road), Financial, Business and Commercial applications using in various skill sets like Kendo UI, MVC, JQuery,  ADO.NET, VisualBasic.NET, C#.NET, Visual Studio  2017/2015/2013/2012/2010/2008/2005/2003 and SQL server 2016/2012/2008/2005.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description: CCWA (Centers Compliance Web Application) is vital to the Baron organization as it is the application used for all Integrity Ops Referrals from the starting point to the end, where it is documented what action was taken for each referral.  As well as housing all observations listened to by Integrity Ops that do not turn into a referral.  This is similar to CXI but at a much large volume and a seamless process.  This application is used by both Internal and External management with security driven by hierarchy. Client Response is used by Internal management to document and close referrals received by Integrity Ops. CPP Remediation is used by External Management to document and close referrals received by Integrity Ops, CXI and Vendor Self-Reported.  This page is also used to remediate all vendor referrals and identify billable incidents’ application   wants the ability for two groups of users to enter in information into a web form that submits data as an individual record into a SQL table that will then be accessed via Microsoft BI. There are multiple pages for these application such as 1st Listener, Quality Review, Send Email, Admin , CPP Remediation, Import SOAR, Vendor and AP/Dim document, Client Response, 5th and 10th Alert Email page, dropdowns maintenance  and Grant users Access page. The first listener page  collects all the information under business call and submit the referral info  in application. There are various types of referral such as Valid, Invalid, Inconclusive, Customer Impact, AP, Pending and Valid below threshold. Admin page retrieves all the referral and Admin has ability to change the referral info. 2nd listener reviews the referral under Quality Review page and grant the referral for further access.  Completing the first and second listener step, Send email page receives that particular referral under Rep ID drop down and selecting the particular referral and submit the send email  button to send  email to supervisor for Rep Id of Referral.

positions.title: Computer Programmer III
positions.description: The DPRP (Diabetes Prevention Recognition Program) provides information to people at high risk of type 2 diabetes, their healthcare providers, and health payers about the location and performance of type 2 diabetes prevention programs across organizations with various delivery modes (in-person, online, and combination.) The purpose of the DPRP is to recognize organizations that have demonstrated their ability to effectively deliver a proven type 2 diabetes prevention lifestyle change program. The recognition program helps to assure that decisions about individual participation, patient referral, and health insurance benefits are based on accurate, reliable, and trustworthy information. The DPRP is further committed to ensuring health equity by increasing access to type 2 diabetes prevention lifestyle change programs among vulnerable populations, including those living in geographically hard to reach or rural areas, through a variety of modalities.

positions.title: SR.PROGRAMMER ANALYST
positions.description: The Goal of the Compliance Audit Tool is to build a web-based tool that allows the Compliance department to record, track, and report the results of their site audits. The Site audits consist of medical record reviews, contract reviews and determination of staff certifications. The CAT3 system is a web based application designed to streamline the workflow of the Hospice Pre-Bill Audit team.  The Auto Mileage application calculates mileage driven by caregivers to patient sites across the country. These miles are then multiplied by the current pay rate and the caregiver is reimbursed on a two week pay cycle. An automated data import brings data into our tables from Horizon.

company.name: Gentiva Health Services, An Affiliate of Kindred at Home

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description: Work Request Management System(WRMS) helps organizations increase client satisfaction by providing streamlined engagement, consistent communication and robust reporting. Work Request Management System (WRMS) is a work entry tool that allows an organization to accept, assign, and manage the flow of incoming requests from internal/external customers.  WRMS also allows for instant notification of all events associated with each request as well as providing customizable ad-hoc reporting experience. There are internal/external customers use WRMS such as AT&T Connected Communities(ACC), Home Solutions Support, Mobility CE, NS PMO, Language and Alternate Channel(LACC), Consumer Back Office(CBO), Business Back Office(BBO),My Metrics, Office Of President and NBO Wireline Order Management. Under all of Organizations, you can submit the request, generate the report, check request details, edit the request status on request status page and drop down for all maintenance page. Supporting Consumer requests for work to be performed by the Consumer Back Office.
